name: domainscout
description: Domain research for AI agents: brainstorm hundreds of names and check them all in one call, with prices and where to buy.

tlds.title: Default TLDs
tlds.description: TLDs tried for names given without one, comma-separated.

namecom_username.title: Name.com username (optional)
namecom_username.description: With a Name.com API token, free names are confirmed by Name.com, with exact prices.

namecom_token.title: Name.com API token (optional)
namecom_token.description: Account Settings → Security → API Tokens on name.com.

cloudflare_account_id.title: Cloudflare account id (optional)
cloudflare_account_id.description: With a Cloudflare API token, free names are confirmed by Cloudflare Registrar.

spaceship_api_key.title: Spaceship API key (optional)
spaceship_api_key.description: With the key and its secret, free names are confirmed by Spaceship. Needs the domains:read scope.

spaceship_api_secret.title: Spaceship API secret (optional)
spaceship_api_secret.description: The secret of the Spaceship API key.

porkbun_api_key.title: Porkbun API key (optional)
porkbun_api_key.description: With the key and its secret, free names are confirmed by Porkbun.

porkbun_secret_key.title: Porkbun secret API key (optional)
porkbun_secret_key.description: The secret key of the Porkbun API key.
